## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what changes for a user. Include a concrete before/after example when useful.

## Validation

- [ ] Applicable panel/voice/native tests pass, or a specific limitation is explained below.
- [ ] Firmware changes compile for both current targets where applicable.
- [ ] Compile-only checks and physical robot tests are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] No credentials, personal firmware binaries, mechanical assets or private history are included.
- [ ] Added code is original or has verified compatible redistribution terms.

## Documentation

List user-facing setup/behavior documentation updated, or explain why none is needed.
